food.guidance: FY31 Capital Markets Day (6 Aug 2026): food adj EBITDA ~Rs5,000 cr by FY31; GOV 2.5-3.5x; consolidated ~Rs10,000 cr adj EBITDA (~4% of GOV) by FY31, GOV ~Rs2.5 lakh cr from Rs67,734 cr FY26. No dated 5% food adj EBITDA/GOV target found. Q2 food margin up 60bps YoY / 30bps QoQ.
food.toing: Standalone affordable-meals app in 50 cities (Q1FY27); JM Financial attributes ~3/4 of annualised Platform Innovation losses to Toing and says it should be discontinued; BofA flags cannibalisation risk (Q2).

Q2FY27.note: Sources disagree: Techportal says NOV Rs6,954 cr (+31.4% YoY) yet Q2FY26 GOV was Rs7,022 cr, so NOV and GOV are different bases; Q1FY27 contribution reported as -0.2% (Inc42) and -0.3% (Techportal).

instamart.guidance: Mgmt believes adj EBITDA losses peaked in Q2FY27; Q3FY27 target: double-digit QoQ NOV growth and ~100bps adj EBITDA margin improvement; shift to inventory-led (1P) model from mid-Q3FY27 over 2-3 quarters, ~80bps better contribution margin and 8-10 days shorter working capital. FY31: GOV Rs1.5+ lakh cr, 40M+ MTU; breakeven needs ~4% contribution. Nomura expects Instamart adj EBITDA loss Rs3,100 cr FY27E and Rs2,300 cr FY28E.
